pointer_policy: Pointers only. This file names which chapter or which appendix table to open. It never carries a value from a table body, and none may be added. Checks that the lookup was well formed. It cannot tell whether the value you read is correct.
addressing: Ids are literal addresses, reached as appendix.<item-id> and chapters.<item-id>. A table and a figure sharing a number get different ids (appendix.table-a-9 vs appendix.figure-a-9) so a request for a table can never silently return a chart. The list is called `appendix` rather than `tables` because it also holds figures and, in some books, lettered appendices that are not tables at all. Table numbers are NOT portable between books.
